draft.title: Organic chemicals from plants
card: Biomass is material from living or recently living things, such as wood, crop waste and algae. Plants build their biomass from carbon dioxide and water, using energy from sunlight.
Crude oil is the source of most organic chemicals today. It formed over millions of years and cannot be replaced in a human lifetime, so it is non-renewable.
Plant biomass is renewable, because new plants can be grown within months or years. Chemists can turn it into solvents, medicines, adhesives, dyes and paints.
Using biomass in place of oil can cut the demand for oil. It still needs land, water and energy to grow and process the plants.
draft.remember: Plants regrow in a human lifetime, oil does not, so biomass can replace oil as a source of organic chemicals.

a.q: Why is plant biomass called a renewable source of organic chemicals?
opts: New plants can be grown within a human lifetime
It releases no carbon dioxide when it is processed
It is made by living things, so it never runs short
It forms deep underground over millions of years
a.why: Biomass is renewable because crops and trees can be regrown within months or years. Oil also came from living things long ago, but it takes millions of years to form, so it cannot be replaced in a human lifetime.
a.clue: Think about how long it takes to replace each source.

b.q: Zara runs a paint company in Ballarat. She wants to cut her use of crude oil, so she makes a solvent from sugarcane waste. What is the best reason this change helps?
opts: Sugarcane can be regrown, so oil is needed less often
Sugarcane needs no land, water or energy to produce
Sugarcane solvents are always safer than oil solvents
Sugarcane waste is made of different elements from oil
b.why: Sugarcane regrows in a short time, so using it lowers the demand for non-renewable oil. The other options say too much: the card says growing and processing plants still need land, water and energy, and nothing says biomass solvents are always safer.
b.clue: Compare how fast each source can be replaced.

a.best: New plants can be grown within a human lifetime

b.best: Sugarcane can be regrown, so oil is needed less often

problems.detail: The right option says oil is 'needed less often', but the card says biomass cuts the demand for oil. Less oil is needed overall, not less often. 'So less oil is needed' would match the card.
